tasks.title: Promote ui-craft to ready 1.0.0 (live evals, portable check, routing, site tests)
tasks.goal: Follow docs/factory/notes/2026-ui-upgrade-handoff.md (UI-2026-01) on branch lab. First run 1-case smoke test (`node src/factory/live-evals.mjs ui-craft --run --case vague-no-surface-ask --engine agy` or `--engine claude`) to confirm CLI quota/hooks work. Then run remaining 7 live cases, save generated HTML into src/skills/ui-craft/evals/live/files/ and verify with checkPage, run portable-check --record, update src/factory/routing/cases.json (r11, r19, r24, ay10 -> ui-craft + uc1..uc4) and routing-evals --run, update tests/site-finder.test.mjs line 172, promote ui-craft to version 1.0.0 status ready. Finally ask PO in chat to approve bumping root package.json (1.0.1 -> 1.1.0) & CHANGELOG.md and committing Session 1 on lab.
acceptanceCriteria: node src/factory/live-evals.mjs ui-craft passes 8/8 from real fresh-agent recordings.
node src/factory/routing-evals.mjs passes 0 failed and 0 stale.
checkPage passes at 1440px and 390px light/dark reduced-motion on live-generated HTML in evals/live/files/.
npm run guard passes with at most one skill (ui-craft) changed.
tasks.verifyCmd: node src/factory/lint-skills.mjs ui-craft && node src/factory/live-evals.mjs ui-craft && node --test tests/ui-craft.test.mjs tests/site-finder.test.mjs && npm run guard
